preamble: Judge one rendered image against a fixed brief. Answer only with the schema. Score 0-10, 10 is a perfect match. This wording is fixed; do not rephrase.

axes.identity: Does the face and hair match the reference? 10 = indistinguishable.
axes.anatomy: Are hands, limbs and joints correct? 10 = no faults.
axes.props: Is every required prop present and held correctly? 10 = all present.
axes.style: Do line and shading match the target style? 10 = exact.

verdict_rule: pass only if every axis scores 7 or more
